name: codex-vault
description: COMET connects Codex to Obsidian-compatible Markdown memory and knowledge graphs.

interface.shortDescription: Search and explore your local Markdown knowledge graph.
interface.longDescription: COMET (Codex–Obsidian Memory Exploration Toolkit) provides local Markdown exploration, backlinks, tags, and knowledge graphs through standard Codex MCP App capabilities. It starts in read-only mode.
defaultPrompt: 搜尋我的 Vault，整理與這個主題最相關的筆記。
顯示目前筆記的 backlinks 與相鄰知識節點。
找出 Vault 中的孤立筆記與失效連結。
